Knows when to abandon a falsified optimization: reverts the fused-projection change and later reverts the kernel back to the verified 10616 baseline, confirming no regression instead of pushing a dead-end design.

Sustained evidence-driven correction of an optimization-induced correctness regression: repeats N=512 checks 30x, tests determinism on the same input, counts fused-path failures, writes isolation scripts iso2-iso6, traces the failing input through stages, and localizes bad rows in the left projection.
Repeated per-stage profiling between edits, showing fixes were driven by measured stage costs rather than guesswork, and re-verified after each design change.

It also reverts falsified optimizations and returns to a verified baseline rather than tweaking constants in circles, matching the level-8 anchor fully and most of level-10 (correction across multiple distinct failures, revisiting design decisions, knowing when to stop).
